remarks: Great Location! Available Immediately! Welcome home to this bright, versatile and well-maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath duplex, just steps from Pemberwick Park in the Glenville School District. The main level features an inviting living room and dining room, eat-in kitchen w/stainless steel appliances, and office or play area. Upstairs, you'll find 2 comfortable bedrooms w/ample closet space and full bath. Lower level offers a 3rd bedroom, 2nd full bath, spacious playroom for flexible living, plus a washer/dryer and plenty of storage. Hardwood floors throughout. Enjoy a great backyard with covered porch, perfect for relaxing or entertaining, with convenient on-street parking. This home offers comfort, functionality, and a fantastic location-ideal for today's lifestyle. No smoking. No pets.
